method: Sequential persistent loopback HTTP requests alternating between release Rust Tauri and production Flask routes in Waitress. RSS covers the entire server process and excludes children. Mokuro multipart upload with a UTF-8 BOM and clear_previous after the file. Compare a 1-volume archive and a 48-volume archive, including 200 page turns and 16 KiB of unrelated metadata per volume. Each round checks the complete response and every persisted daily entry. One warmup per server and file size.
